verdict.rationale: Reflect has no native rule or trigger engine. Event-driven automation is possible only through Zapier, which docs say can connect Reflect with other apps, plus integrations such as adding Trello/Asana tasks or Slack notes, and a limited API that appends data to notes. Built-in automatic behaviors like Kindle sync and bookmarks landing in the daily note are fixed, not user-defined rules. Missing for 10: native user-defined rules/triggers inside Reflect, documentation of which Reflect events can act as triggers, outbound webhooks, and hands-on corroboration of Zapier-based automations.
